prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 10 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1343; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the other vehicle was changing lanes. The reported mechanism, including the direction of impact and the force involved, is consistent with the knee injury diagnosed at intake. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the injury, and the clinical picture supports the history given by the patient. The patient has a remote history of a minor strain in the same area, which resolved completely with conservative care and did not affect function prior to this event. Over the course of ten visits, treatment proceeded with physical therapy, range-of-motion work, and periodic reassessment. The course ran somewhat longer than is typical for this type of injury, reflecting a slower but steady recovery rather than any gap or change in plan. Billing records reviewed for this episode show no repeated charges for the same services. Current status shows improved strength and motion, with ongoing home exercise and follow-up as needed.
